description:
TikTok 47.1.4 feed filtering now includes creator-disclosed paid partnerships and promotional LIVE cards that lack the usual ad or product flags. This release also includes the resource repair from 1.3.0 for the confirmation toast shown after voting in comment polls.

- **Hide ads:** removes paid partnerships, self-promotions and nonempty commercial LIVE disclosures using TikTok's native metadata.
- **Hide Shop videos:** recognizes commerce tag `1000001` even when current-goods and product-count fields are absent. Ordinary LIVE streams and selling permission alone remain unaffected.
- **Change package name:** restores the original layout behavior references lost during resource rebuilding, including the poll confirmation toast; fixes manifest metadata removal in Manager.
- The same five selectable patches remain available. The Shop tab remains accessible.

Validation: behavior checks, 32 runtime member checks against the original APK, six bytecode patch combinations and comparison of all 126 compiled layout behavior declarations passed. An actual paid-partnership video model was retained by 1.3.0 and removed by 1.4.0 in the emulator. Native Android LIVE fixtures verified the new metadata rules and ordinary LIVE retention. The specific reported LIVE broadcasts and an actual poll vote remain unverified.

In ReVanced Manager, update the patch source, select a fresh original TikTok 47.1.4 APK, and enable **Hide ads** and **Hide Shop videos**. Keep only one source for this bundle: remove older local imports or duplicate remote/local copies before patching, since Manager can load older bundle classes even when their patches are unselected. Apply the patches and install the resulting APK using your existing signing key.

The permanent Manager update feed is:

```text
https://github.com/niposch/revanced-tiktok-patches/releases/latest/download/patches.json
```

Assets contain the patch bundle, reviewed GPL source, documentation and checksums. App APKs, investigation captures and signing keys are excluded.
